title: Q-CIFAIL-ultrastable-executor: executor is failing in ultrastable/ultrastable
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every executor run and every ciwatch run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ciwatch --probe ultrastable/ultrastable executor
**Status:** closed

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-19T08:34:23Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists


**Evidence:** closing probe passed (2 consecutive passes after a recorded failure): exit 0


**Relapse:** 2026-11-23T00:14:24Z closing probe failed again: exit 1 (reopen 1; closes again only after 2 passes over 60 minutes)

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-23T00:14:38Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 123.5 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
